scripts.compile: bun run build && bun build cli/uni.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --outfile dist/uni && ls -lh dist/uni && gzip -c dist/uni | wc -c | awk '{printf "gzip: %.1fM\n", $1/1024/1024}'
scripts.compile:light: bun build cli/uni-light.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --outfile dist/uni-light && ls -lh dist/uni-light && gzip -c dist/uni-light | wc -c | awk '{printf "gzip light: %.1fM\n", $1/1024/1024}'
scripts.compile:all: bun run build && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && bun build cli/uni.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/uni-linux-x64 && bun build cli/uni-light.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/uni-light-linux-x64 && bun build cli/uni.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/uni-darwin-arm64 && bun build cli/uni.ts --compile --minify --sourcemap=none --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/uni-linux-arm64 && ls -lh dist/ && gzip -c dist/uni-linux-x64 | wc -c | awk '{printf "gzip linux-x64: %.1fM\n", $1/1024/1024}'
